label: Jelly radio
desc: A radio group whose chosen dot squashes and wobbles like jelly; native radios keep arrow keys, forms and screen readers working.
use: Plan pickers, preference lists and any short single-choice group.

label: Lattice loader
desc: A grid of linked nodes with a diagonal pulse of light sweeping across it; a static graded frame under reduced motion.
use: Loading states for syncing, indexing or connecting; inline or centred in a panel.

label: Paper crumple
desc: A sheet of paper that crumples into a ball when discarded and smooths out again on restore.
use: Discard or delete actions for notes, drafts and sticky cards.

label: Peek rating
desc: A star rating that previews the score on hover or focus, lifting neighbouring stars and naming the rating before you commit.
use: Feedback prompts, review forms and product or article ratings.

label: Pulse heart
desc: A like toggle whose heart pops with a ripple and a ring of sparks, then keeps a slow heartbeat while liked.
use: Like or favourite buttons on posts, products and gallery items.

label: Refine frame
desc: A frame holding a soft draft picture that snaps into focus as its corner marks tighten and a focus line sweeps through.
use: Before/after image treatments, upscale or enhance actions and AI-image previews.

label: Rubber segment
desc: A segmented control whose highlight stretches like a rubber band: the leading edge overshoots and the trailing edge follows.
use: View switchers, period pickers and compact filters.

label: Scrub field
desc: A number field whose label is a drag handle: scrub sideways to change the value with a ruler, or type, or use the arrow keys.
use: Design-tool style property inputs, sliders for opacity, radius, size and spacing.

label: Shredder
desc: A paper shredder: the document feeds into the slot and drops out as loose strips; one button shreds, then restores.
use: Permanent delete or secure erase actions, confirmation moments for sensitive documents.

label: Slide commit
desc: A slide-to-confirm track: drag the handle across to commit, release early and it springs back; Enter or Space works from the keyboard.
use: Payments, sends and other irreversible actions that deserve a deliberate gesture.
